verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Open WebUI's extensibility mechanisms (Functions, Tools, Pipelines, MCP support, Skills) but contains no evidence of an actual marketplace scale — no counts of published skills/plugins, no data on active maintainers, and no community directory of add-ons. In fact, community commentary points the other way, with users citing licensing-change backlash and reduced motivation to contribute (open-webui-comm-7, open-webui-comm-8), undermining the notion of a thriving, actively-maintained plugin ecosystem.
